title: 视线慢慢转过去
description: 成人站姿平稳，头颈在舒服范围转向一侧，肩膀自然落下。

art_direction.medium: crisp digital comic ink and quiet halftone shadows
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult stands in a quiet warmup area and turns the head only a little toward the nearby window, shoulders level and hands loosely clasped in front. Both feet remain planted and the torso faces forward. Show an easy natural neck position, without pulling the head by hand or tilting dramatically. A plain bag on a distant bench and the edge of a climbing mat provide subtle training context. Use a soft graphite-and-watercolor illustration with precise posture contours, luminous color washes, and cool blue balanced by warm ochre. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels.
